name: hbm_su_cx_ijs_1018

pin_regs.reason: Every pin is registered in RTL (inputs land in pin registers / banks, every output is a register); a wrapper stage would move the fixed 3:4 seam calendar edges.

structural_change: CX-IJ 10-18: the two-root ij leaf carries two 3:4 crossings inside one leaf (ijd_slot clk_s -> ipv / ipgb / ibad clk_q, and io_slot clk_q -> idl clk_s, 3 x 1,024 b), the defect that failed routes hbm_su_cx_dl_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -166.7 / FF -95.1) and hbm_su_cx_rc_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -173.4 / FF -77.9): related-clock STA times a 3:4 crossing at the VCO tick (setup 277.8 ps, coincident-edge hold) less the 150 / 100 distinct-entry reserve. Fix (dl/rc split, S81 x34 _s/_t precedent): one root per half; the crossings become 2-bank seams (static calendar windows >= 3 quanta for setup and rewrite-after-read), die-level 3:4 seam arcs. Lockstep vs the hub on Verilator 5.050 PASS QID 2 and QID 0 (checks=24183); mutants 1/2/3/4 FAIL. ij_s (stream, x1 per quarter): W seam to ij_q 2,114 b (5.6/um), E inj_d / request 1,186 b (3.1/um); clock/reset N centre. HH-1 10-18 regate: 216 -> 108 um wide (gate 216 x 388.8, util 1.7%: GPL-0305 RePlAce divergence, no CTS / GRT); 108 x 388.8 keeps both faces <= 6/um, util ~3.5% (closed dl_s 2.6%), ob -> idl -> inj_d runs W -> E over 108 um; the pair abuts as a 324 x 388.8 block (old two-root leaf 388.8 x 388.8).
